current_finding: MSU protocol: random allocation between CHOP and LOPP for untreated confirmed peripheral T-cell lymphoma; excludes indolent/cutaneous disease and major contraindications. Four–six months of therapy; clinic pays first treatment and followups; owner pays other bloodwork and treatments. Short prior steroids may be considered.

MSU canine histiocytic sarcoma including hemophagocytic variant; 2 groups of eight dogs, four weekly doses then breaks, 16-week regimen; tumor burden limit and ≥20kg; initial evaluation owner-paid, subsequent defined trial treatment covered.

Current MSU cutaneous MCT protocol: trunk lesions 2–6cm, no mets, no comparable treatment in preceding 7 days, NSAID washout five days. Prednisone plus antihistamines and surgery around day 14. Up to 50% surgery and histopathology covered, approved trial meds covered.

Current MSU metastatic feline mammary carcinoma protocol, miR-10b overexpression, repetitive nanoparticle treatment and CT/MRI visits, prior surgery/chemo permitted, covers investigational therapy and linked imaging.
